claims: As of March 22, 2026, the PlayStation Network experienced a widespread outage affecting games and social features.
PlayStation Network services are currently in the process of being restored.
Sony indicates most services are back online.
The PlayStation Status page states that a major, widespread outage occurred on Saturday evening.
Gaming, social features, and app access were down.
Reports on Downdetector indicate a significant drop in issues.
Some users still face login or connectivity issues
